_note: NB309: acronyms assumed known to a developer audience, so using one without expanding it is not a finding. This allowlist IS the rule — the check is only as good as the list is generous, and a miss here is a false positive in someone's docs. Deliberately broad: web, protocol, data-format, infra, licence, and process abbreviations that a reader of technical documentation meets daily. Entries are uppercase and matched after stripping a trailing plural 's' and any possessive, so one entry covers API/APIs/API's.
_extending: A domain has its own everyday acronyms (a Kubernetes doc says CRD and RBAC constantly; an RF doc says LNA). Those are known to their audience and cannot be enumerated here, so the rule reports only the FIRST use of each and projects extend the list with known_acronyms in [tool.nabokov]. If a project's docs trip this rule a lot, the list is the thing to grow — not the rule to switch off.
